progressBasis: LCM-01 PR #490 adds Joomla integration tests proving existing certificates remain owned and downloadable after course states 0/2/-2 and after upgrade, while classroom resume is denied. The tests found and fixed an SQL binding regression in pending PDF rendering. Prior PRs #484/#486/#488 cover learning access, administrative migration/notifications and historical dashboard. Conservative weighted estimate unchanged (81+81+78+99+68+92+70+72+75)/9 = 79.56% (rounded 80%). Manual Joomla acceptance, backup/storage restore and remaining endpoint/race audit pending.
